entries.title: OpenAI 短信国家过滤语义
entries.summary: ### OpenAI 短信国家过滤语义 OpenAI 短信国家过滤必须按运行时缓存的区域集合计算：最终可见国家 = 当前平台支持国家 - (whatsapp_regions - sms_regions)。如果某国家同时存在于 sms_regions 与 whatsapp_regions，必须保留显示，因为 sms 区域优先于 WhatsApp 排除。该规则属于运行时设置与国家选择器的共享业务约束，后续 UI、API、缓存刷新与文档都必须保持一致。

entries.title: High-Level Structure
entries.summary: - `ui/` contains the React renderer UI. - `src-tauri/` owns desktop shell integration, menu/tray wiring, bundled defaults, and app lifecycle. - `crates/sms-core/` contains provider abstractions, runtime state, routing, option cache, and tic

entries.title: Layer Boundaries
entries.summary: - UI should talk to runtime only through service modules under `ui/src/services`. - Provider protocol behavior belongs in Rust provider implementations, not in React components. - Manifest persistence, option cache refresh, and routing rule

entries.title: State Ownership
entries.summary: - Runtime snapshot and provider manifests are shared application state in frontend hooks, not per-component local state. - Ticket truth comes from backend runtime snapshot; UI-only safeguards may exist, but backend remains source of truth.

entries.title: Plugin And Provider Rules
entries.summary: - Provider-specific protocol differences are handled via manifest config and provider implementations. - `mock` providers are special-cased and should not leak into normal production routing or activation flows. - Auto-routing only consider

entries.title: Persistence And Config
entries.summary: - App config and default provider manifests are seeded by Tauri into user config directories. - Runtime state (tickets, logs, activity, reuse pool, provider balance cache, OpenAI regions cache) is persisted via `RuntimeStore` backed by SQLi

entries.title: Change Constraints
entries.summary: - UI fixes should preserve existing design-system structure under `ui/src/components` and `ui/src/app`. - Cross-layer changes should keep API contracts synchronized, especially `TicketRecord`, provider summaries, and runtime snapshot payloa

entries.title: Imports And Module Style
entries.summary: - Frontend prefers grouped ES imports with type-only imports where useful. - Local imports are relative and typically grouped by layer: app types, hooks, services, then utilities. - Rust modules are split by responsibility such as `service`

entries.title: State And React Patterns

entries.title: Dark Mode Notes
entries.summary: Dark mode uses the same component patterns. Background tokens shift to dark values. The `[data-theme="dark"]` overrides in theme.css handle all of this automatically. Do not add separate dark: Tailwind variants unless absolutely necessary.

entries.summary: - ❌ Opaque white cards on blue-gray bg (looks flat, not glass) - ❌ `bg-ds-surface` without `backdrop-blur-ds` (glass needs blur to activate) - ❌ Heavy `rgba(0,0,0,0.12)` borders on glass cards (too dark, disrupts translucency) - ❌ `#0066cc`

entries.title: Detected Signals
entries.summary: - `package.json` defines a production `build` workflow for the frontend via `vite build`. - Rust workspace structure implies `cargo check` / `cargo test` quality gates for backend crates. - `tsconfig.json` has `strict: true`, which means Ty

entries.title: Expected Validation
entries.summary: - Frontend changes should at minimum pass `npm run build`. - Rust/runtime changes should run the most relevant `cargo test` or `cargo check` target when touched. - API contract changes should be validated across UI types and Rust response m

entries.title: Review Priorities
entries.summary: - Catch UI state drift between local draft state and runtime truth. - Catch provider-specific regressions around enable/disable flows, release rules, and routing. - Prefer small, atomic changes with clear user-visible verification paths.

entries.title: Uncertain Areas
entries.summary: - No dedicated ESLint or Prettier config was detected in the repo root. Mark formatting/lint rules as convention-driven rather than tool-enforced. - No CI workflow directory was detected locally. Treat local build/test commands as the prima

entries.title: Test Conventions
entries.summary: # Test Conventions

entries.title: Detected Test Patterns
entries.summary: - Rust unit tests live inline in source modules using `#[test]`. - Frontend has screenshot/design fixture support under `ui/src/testing` and scripts in `package.json`. - No dedicated Jest or Vitest suite was detected for `ui/src`.

entries.title: Practical Expectations
entries.summary: - For Rust behavior changes, prefer local module unit tests near the implementation. - For UI behavior changes, validate with `npm run build` and use screenshot tooling when visual behavior matters. - When changing shared contracts, verify

entries.title: Naming And Placement
entries.summary: - Rust tests follow descriptive `snake_case` names and are colocated in the source file they validate. - UI screenshot fixtures and design scenes live under `ui/src/testing`.

entries.title: Gaps
entries.summary: - Frontend interaction-level automated tests appear limited. Behavior-sensitive UI changes may need manual verification notes until a broader test harness exists.

entries.title: UI Conventions
entries.summary: # UI Conventions

entries.title: Deferred: SmsBower exact_reuse
entries.summary: SmsBower exact_reuse path deferred until sufficient API evidence is gathered. SmsBower stays at SameActivationRetry only. -- Chosen to defer: no documented endpoint for exact number reuse in SmsBower API.

entries.title: Deferred: Pool ranking / cost heuristics
entries.summary: No priority ordering within pool candidates for now. First-match is sufficient. -- Chosen to defer: premature optimization without usage data.

entries.title: Deferred: Cross-provider reuse
entries.summary: A number from provider A is never offered to provider B. Pool is provider-scoped. -- Chosen to defer: no use case identified and would violate provider isolation.

entries.title: Deferred: UI visibility of pool state
entries.summary: UI display of reuse pool candidates, hit rates, and eviction events. -- Chosen to defer: Phase 3 (Operator Closure) concern.

entries.title: Deferred: Full pool entry detail view
entries.summary: Raw pool entries with phone numbers and expiry for advanced debugging. -- Chosen to defer: summary-level visibility sufficient for v1; raw phone exposure is security concern.

entries.title: Deferred: Reuse success/failure metrics dashboard
entries.summary: Aggregate hit rate, miss rate, eviction rate metrics. -- Chosen to defer: future observability phase.

entries.title: Deferred: Automated visual regression tests
entries.summary: No visual test framework exists. Manual checklist for now. -- Chosen to defer: tooling investment not justified for current scope.

entries.title: Deferred: intent_reuse vs exact_reuse UI distinction
entries.summary: Both show as Reused badge in v1. Backend-internal distinction not surfaced to operator. -- Chosen to defer: operator feedback needed to justify added complexity.
